user.title: Heating system
user.description: Add heat sources, circuits and consumers afterwards on the integration page.

data_description.name: For example the building.
data_description.loss_kw: Heat lost all the time by a storage tank and pipes, in kW. It is taken off before the split. Leave empty if unknown.
Heat lost all the time by a storage tank and pipes, in kW. It is taken off before the split. Leave empty if unknown.

source.title: Heat source
source.description: An entity that counts energy or fuel. Its increase, converted to heat, is split between the consumers.

data_description.entity_id: A meter reading that only increases, e.g. heat or electricity in kWh, gas in m³ or oil in L.

data_description.factor: kWh of heat per unit of the reading. Default: 0.9 for efficiency, 3.0 for COP. Not used for heat.
data_description.factor_entity_id: Current COP of the heat pump. While it is unavailable, the factor applies.

error.wrong_domain: This type of entity is not supported here.
error.not_cumulative: Choose a meter reading, not a momentary value.
error.factor_entity_cop_only: A COP sensor only works with the conversion electricity × COP.
error.source_exists: This entity is already a heat source.

circuit.title: Heating circuit
circuit.description: Radiators behind one pump. Without a running pump, none of them gets heat.

data_description.name: For example the floor.
data_description.pump_entity_id: Binary sensor that is on while the circuit pump runs. Without it, the circuit counts as always running.

error.wrong_domain: This type of entity is not supported here.

radiator.title: Radiator
radiator.description: Gets a share of the heat by its size and demand.

data_description.name: For example the room.
data_description.circuit: Without a circuit, the radiator is always supplied.
data_description.demand_entity_id: Thermostat, heating demand or valve position in %, or an on/off actuator. Without one, the radiator counts as always heating.

data_description.demand_type: Only for a demand sensor in %.
data_description.size_type: By default, all radiators count as equal.
data_description.size_value: Floor area in m² or nominal power in W, as chosen above.
data_description.meter_entity_id: Measures the heat of this radiator. Replaces the estimate.

demand_suggestion.title: Demand in %
demand_suggestion.description: {sensor} reports the heating demand of {climate} in percent. That is more accurate than heating on/off.

data_description.use_suggestion: Off: use heating on/off of the thermostat.

hot_water.title: Hot water
hot_water.description: Gets heat while its charging pump runs.

data_description.name: For example the storage tank.
data_description.demand_entity_id: Binary sensor that is on while the hot water pump runs.

data_description.charging_power_kw: Heat while the pump runs, in kW. Default: 10 kW.
data_description.meter_entity_id: Measures the heat for hot water. Replaces the estimate.

error.wrong_domain: This type of entity is not supported here.
error.not_cumulative: Choose a meter reading, not a momentary value.
error.size_value_required: Enter the area or nominal power for this size.
